This app is an open-source client for Clash Meta. Source code is public; you can inspect, build, and redistribute it under the project license.
This project is permanently free. No paid unlock, subscription wall, or official commercial edition exists for this client.

Beware of scams: anyone selling this app, charging “activation fees”, or claiming exclusive paid support for this free client is unauthorized. Prefer releases from https://github.com/Chloemlla/ClashMetaForAndroid or F-Droid.
This project is licensed under GPL-3.0. Tap to open the full license text.

Relative to upstream MetaCubeX/CMFA, this fork’s first-install splash summarizes production deltas by Android module. Full inventory: README → Branch Improvements.

First-install open-source gate · Alpha→Meta same-signature migration · LumenCrash host install/report · cold-start order and flash-exit guards · notification permission UX · immersive update-notes gate · Android 17 (API 37) target + edge-to-edge

Progressive proxy delay + animation · proxy search · live speed and traffic trend on home · connection aggregation · bounded log filtering · empty-profile / home setup CTAs · clipboard subscription import · undraw optional wallpaper-color empty states · accessibility and 48dp touch targets

Live Update status notification (promoted ongoing) · POST_NOTIFICATIONS guards · sharedpref-only backup · Access Control stop timeout · external VPN control denied by default · partner auto-adapt (PiliPlus/NexAI/Project-Lumen/Zhihu++/Aura/CDict)
Mihomo bridge retained · subscription-userinfo / Go-side fetch and related kernel sync from upstream kept current
App-wide CoroutineExceptionHandler · Components / Intent security boundary · internal-only control paths for shortcuts
